run_bench_super_kmeans_synthetic: run the benchmark comparing faiss SuperKMeans against vanilla Clustering on synthetic Gaussian mixture data
run_bench_super_kmeans_fvecs: run the benchmark comparing faiss SuperKMeans against vanilla Clustering on a .fvecs input file
create_gaussian_mixture_data: create synthetic Gaussian mixture data with k random centers and n samples for k-means benchmarking
run_vanilla_clustering: run faiss vanilla Clustering training on float32 data and return wall time, final objective, and iteration count
run_super_kmeans: run faiss SuperKMeans training on float32 data and return wall time, objective, iterations, and GEMM pruning rates
